12:2: and gives birth to a male child
she will be ritually unclean for seven days;
as the days of the state of her impure ‘separation’, she will be unclean.
12:5: If she gives birth to a female
she will be unclean for fourteen days as during her ‘separation’.
she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure.
12:7: He will bring it before Adonoy and atone for her
and she will be cleansed from the impurity of her blood;
this is the law regarding the woman who gives birth
to a male or to a female.
13:2: When a person will have, in the skin of his flesh a spot of deep whiteness or an off-white spot, or a snow-white spot,
and it forms on the skin of his body [like] the plague of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas],
he shall be brought to Aharon, the kohein,
or to one of his sons, the kohanim.
13:3: The kohein shall see the plague in the skin of the flesh and [if] the hair in the skin-eruption has turned white and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the skin of his body,
The kohein shall see it and declare him [to be] unclean.
13:5: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day
and behold! [if] the skin-eruption has remained as it was;
the skin-eruption did not increase in the skin.
The kohein shall confine him for seven days, a second time,
13:6: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day for the second time
and behold! [if] the skin-eruption became dimmer
and the skin-eruption did not increase in the skin,
the kohein shall declare him [to be] clean; it is [merely] a removed white discoloration.
He shall wash his garments and he will be cleansed.
13:7: in the skin after it was shown to the kohein, who pronounced that it was clean,
it must be shown a second time to the kohein.
13:8: and behold! [if] the removed white discoloration has increased in the skin,
the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is ‘confinement’ [tzoraas].
13:9: When there is a skin-eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas]
he shall be brought to the kohein.
13:10: The kohein shall see and behold! there is a deep white spot on the skin
and it has turned the hair white
or there is an impression of healthy flesh in the spot of deep whiteness,
13:11: it is an old ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] in the skin of his body
and the kohein shall declare him unclean
13:12: And if the ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] sprouts on the skin
and if the ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] covered the entire skin of the [one affected by] the eruption
from his head until his feet
to the extent that the kohein can see.
13:13: The kohein shall see and behold! the ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] has covered all of his body,
he shall declare the skin-eruption to be cleansed,
it has turned completely white, he is clean.
13:15: The kohein shall see the healthy flesh and declare him unclean.
The healthy flesh is unclean, it is ‘confinement’ [tzoraas].
13:16: Or, if the healthy flesh turns again and it was changed to white,
he shall be brought to the kohein.
13:19: If there was on the area of the inflammation a spot of deep whiteness
or a snow-white spot tinged with red
it shall be shown to the kohein.
13:20: The kohein shall see it and behold! its appearance is lower than the skin,
and its hair has turned white,
the kohein shall declare him unclean; It is the skin-eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] that has sprouted through the inflammation.
13:22: the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is a skin eruption.
13:23: If the snow-white spot remains in its place and it did not increase,
it is [merely] an impression of the inflammation
and the kohein shall declare him clean.
13:24: has on his skin a burn from a fire
and [on] the impression of the burnt part, came a snow-white spot tinged with red or pure white spot.
13:25: The kohein shall see it and behold! the hair has turned white in the snow-white spot and its appearance is deeper than the skin;
that has sprouted in the burn.
The kohein shall declare him unclean,
13:27: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day.
If it has increased in the skin,
the kohein shall declare him unclean,
13:28: If the snow-white spot remains in its place and it did not increase in the skin and it is faint,
it is the deep white spot of the burn.
The kohein shall declare him clean
for it is [merely] the impression of the burn.
13:30: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption, and behold! its appearance is deeper than the skin
and there is thin reddish hair in it.
The kohein shall pronounce it unclean, It is a nesek,
it is ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] of the head or the beard.
13:32: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption on the seventh day,
and behold! the nesek did not increase
and there was no reddish hair in it
and the appearance of the nesek
is not deeper than the skin.
13:33: He shall shave around the nesek but he shall not shave close to the nesek,
and the kohein shall confine the nesek for a second seven day period.
13:34: The kohein shall see the nesek on the seventh day and behold! if the nesek did not increase in the skin
and its appearance is not deeper than the skin.
The kohein shall declare him clean.
He shall wash his garments and he will be clean.
13:35: If the nesek increases [extensively] in the skin
13:36: and behold! the nesek has increased in the skin.
The kohein shall not [even] look for reddish hair, he is unclean.
13:42: If there will be, in the baldness in back of the head or in the baldness in front of the head
a white skin-eruption, tinged with red,
in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness.
13:43: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the spot of deep whiteness is tinged with red
in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness
just as the appearance ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] of the skin of the flesh.
13:44: He is a person with ‘confinement’ [tzoraas], he is unclean.
The kohein shall declare him unclean; his skin-eruption is on his head.
13:45: The one who is ‘confined’ — [the person] who has the skin-eruption — his garments shall have a tear in them, his hair shall be grown long,
and he must cover his head down to his upper lip like a mourner,
and do not become unclean, do not become unclean, shall he call out.
13:47: When in a garment there is a skin-eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas],
13:49: If the plague is green or red, in the garment, or in the leather hide or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or if it is in any object made of leather;
and it shall be shown to the kohein.
13:51: He shall see the eruption on the seventh day. If the eruption has increased in the garment or in the warp thread, or in the woof thread, or in the leather hide,
or in the work made of leather,
it is a ‘confinement’ of loss [tzoraas], it is unclean.
13:52: He shall burn the garment, or the warp [lengthwise] threads, or the woof [widthwise] threads, be it in wool or in linen,
or in all leather made objects,
in which there is the eruption.
For it is a ‘confinement’ of loss [tzoraas].
It shall be burned in fire.
13:53: and behold! the eruption did not increase
in the garment, or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads,
or in any leather made object.
13:55: The kohein shall see it after the eruption was washed and behold! [even if] the eruption did not change from what it was and the eruption did not increase;
you shall burn it in fire.
be it in a worn [garment] or in a new [garment].
13:59: This is the law of the eruption of ‘confinement’ [tzoraas] be it in a woolen garment, or a linen garment, or in the warp [lengthwise] thread, or in the woof [widthwise] thread,
that it be pronounced pure, or that it be pronounced impure.
